projects.title: Meeting Room Reservation System
projects.shortDescription: Full stack web system for meeting room reservations management in corporate environment
projects.problem: Manual paper-based control generated scheduling conflicts, rework, and low employee adoption across two company locations.
projects.solution: Centralized web application with interactive calendar and automatic notifications, completely digitalizing the reservation process.
impact: 150+ active users across 2 locations (headquarters and branch)
100+ bookings processed monthly
Elimination of scheduling conflicts
90% reduction in room reservation time
Email notifications
projects.infrastructureRole: Docker deployment on Linux server, automated backup, uptime monitoring, and centralized logs.

projects.title: AI-Powered Sales Forecast Platform
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack platform that replaces forecast spreadsheets with a collaborative flow featuring approvals, audit trail, and AI-assisted forecasting
projects.problem: Multiple sales units consolidated monthly forecasts in loose email spreadsheets: each manager filled their own, consolidation was manual, approvals happened outside the file, and there was no reliable history of who changed what.
projects.solution: Web platform with a state-based flow (draft → submission → approval), an AI engine that tests 6 statistical time-series models per product/unit and selects the one with the lowest error, and consolidated dashboards comparing budgeted × forecast × actual sales.
impact: Complete replacement of spreadsheets with a single flow with full audit trail
AI engine tests 6 statistical models per series and automatically selects the lowest-error one
Bidirectional ERP integration for data sync and results export
4 access profiles with backend-enforced authorization (manager, PCP, IT, read-only)
Multi-language interface (Portuguese, English, and Spanish)
projects.infrastructureRole: Docker Compose orchestration with Traefik as reverse proxy, Airflow DAGs for ERP sync and forecast engine execution, dual authentication (user JWT + static token for internal Airflow calls).

Sales and competition data available for strategic analysis
Support for Marketing department's market intelligence

projects.title: Capacity Management System for Stability Studies
projects.shortDescription: Platform that controls medical product stability studies and automatically allocates incubator/chamber capacity via an optimization algorithm
projects.problem: Stability study tracking and sample allocation in incubators/chambers was done manually, with no visibility into available capacity or systematic conflict checking between concurrent studies.
projects.solution: Allocation engine that calculates, for each study, which incubators meet the required temperature/humidity conditions, checks capacity and height conflicts between studies with overlapping windows, and suggests the best allocation prioritizing reuse of shelves already in use.
impact: Allocation algorithm replaces manual incubator capacity control
Automatic conflict detection between concurrent studies by period and physical capacity
Full tracking of the sample pull-point cycle per study
Versioning with Conventional Commits and automated releases (semantic-release)
projects.infrastructureRole: Docker containers behind Traefik, schema versioned with Prisma Migrate, semantic release pipeline with Conventional Commits.

projects.title: Accounting Apportionment Automation Platform
projects.shortDescription: Modular platform that automates recurring accounting postings, reconciles documents, and integrates with the corporate ERP
projects.problem: Recurring accounting postings (monthly fees, deductions, and vendor invoices) were processed manually across multiple departments, with reconciliation prone to error and no audit trail of who posted what.
projects.solution: Platform with a pluggable module architecture — each apportionment process is auto-discovered at startup, allowing new processes to be added without changing the core system. It reconciles received documents, automatically posts to the ERP, and notifies the responsible department by email.
impact: Plugin architecture: new apportionment processes are added without touching the application core
Dual ERP base strategy (reads from the official base, writes to the test base) for safe production rollout — environment switch via a configuration variable
Anti-partial lock: multi-document postings are only confirmed in the ERP when all items are accepted
Access control by area/department with automatic notification to the responsible team
projects.infrastructureRole: Python backend (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0) with idempotent migrations, Docker deployment behind Traefik, automated quality gate with ruff and mypy.
